cities.base: Lakeside Bled, a short walk back from the water to keep costs down
cities.name: Bled

cities.base: Bovec or Kobarid guesthouse, whichever has availability, as the Soča Valley base
cities.name: Bovec/Kobarid

cities.base: Old town, walkable to the castle funicular and the airport bookend night
cities.name: Ljubljana

places.name: Odprta Kuhna (Open Kitchen)
places.note: Friday street food market on Pogačarjev trg with stalls from Ljubljana restaurants, running mid-March to the end of October, so it is closed now until spring. Times are not published, so check before you plan a Friday around it.

places.name: Gostilna AS
places.note: Tucked in a passage off Vodnikov trg, seafood-leaning Slovenian cooking, a step up from the tourist-menu places on the main square. Book ahead if you want a table on your one night in town.

places.name: Tivoli Park
places.note: The city's big green space, an easy flat walk if you want air without a car. Not essential on a one-night stay but redeems a grey morning.

places.name: Metelkova City
places.note: Squatted former military barracks turned into an alternative art and nightlife complex, covered in murals and graffiti. Feels different from anywhere else in the city, worth a walk-through even if you don't stay for a bar.

places.name: Ljubljana Central Market (Plečnikove tržnice)
places.note: Plečnik's riverside colonnade, built 1940 to 1944, with the fish market on the lower floor and produce stalls outside. Winter 06:00 to 16:00 Mon to Sat outdoors, covered halls to 14:00 on Saturday, shut Sundays and holidays; coffee and a wander, not a meal.

places.name: Dragon Bridge (Zmajski most)
places.note: Four bronze dragons, the city's unofficial symbol. Two minutes off the main riverside walk, easy to fold in. A public bridge, free to cross at any hour.

places.name: Prešeren Square
places.note: The pink Franciscan Church anchors it and everyone passes through, so treat it as a free bench to sit and reorient rather than a destination. It is an open square, there at any hour.

places.name: Tromostovje (Triple Bridge)
places.note: Plečnik's signature piece, connects the old town to Prešeren Square. You'll cross it a few times without trying to.

places.name: Ljubljana Castle
places.note: Funicular up for the view over the rooftops and the Julian Alps, then walk the ramparts; the ticket also covers the viewing tower, Museum of Puppetry and Slovenian History exhibition. EUR 17.10 online (19 at the door) with funicular, winter 09:00 to 18:00, open every day.

places.name: Napoleon Bridge (Napoleonov most)
places.note: Stone bridge over a striking turquoise stretch of the Soča, on the Walk of Peace trail, quick stop and a good photo, free.

places.name: Boka Waterfall viewpoint
places.note: One of Slovenia's tallest waterfalls but you only see it well from a distant roadside viewpoint unless you do a steep scramble; Kozjak gives a better up-close payoff for similar effort.

places.name: Soča River rafting or kayaking trip
places.note: Several outfitters run trips down the Soča out of Bovec, cold glacial water even in summer. Worth doing if you have any spare time in Bovec beyond the fixed itinerary, but it will eat half a day.

places.name: Kavarna Konoba Kobarid
places.note: Simple lunch stop on the main square in Kobarid, easy to combine with the museum, nothing fancy but dependable.

places.name: Straza Bled viewpoint and toboggan
places.note: Small hill above town with a chairlift and toboggan run; reviews put one toboggan ride at about 15 euros and two at 25. Listed hours are 11:00 to 18:00 daily but the November season is not confirmed, so check before you go.

places.name: Vila Bled restaurant
places.note: Tito's former villa on the lakeshore, now a hotel restaurant with the best formal dining room view of the lake. Book ahead, prices reflect the setting more than the food.

places.name: Kluže Fortress
places.note: A 15th-century wooden fort against Turkish raids, rebuilt in stone and used in WWI; Fort Hermann above it dates from 1897 to 1900 and was shelled by Italy. Fri to Sun in April and May, daily June to September, otherwise groups only, so closed now; adult EUR 5.

places.name: Soča River viewpoint at Trnovo ob Soči bridge
places.note: The turquoise color everyone photographs from the road bridges. Free, just pull over, five minutes is enough unless you want to swim.

places.name: Kobarid Museum
places.note: Small, well done museum on the WWI Isonzo Front and the 12th battle (Caporetto), the setting of Hemingway's 'A Farewell to Arms'. Open every day, 10:00 to 17:00 October to March, longer in summer; a good rainy-day option, check the price.

places.name: Italian Ossuary (Kostnica) Kobarid
places.note: Mussolini-era WWI ossuary on the hill above town, walk up from the church for the view over the Soča valley, free and quick.

places.name: Mala korita Soče (small gorge of the Soča)
places.note: Short roadside gorge walk, free, easy to miss, worth the five minute stop if you're driving between Bovec and the Vršič side.

places.name: Gostilna Dnk Bovec
places.note: Solid Slovenian home cooking, goulash and local trout, no frills, reliable dinner after a day on the trails.

places.name: Hiša Franko
places.note: Ana Roš's restaurant, one of the world's best-known tasting menus, book weeks ahead; open Wednesday to Sunday, lunch 12:00 to 16:00 and dinner 19:00 to 23:00. Expensive, a splurge rather than a casual dinner, but the night to spend it if food matters.

places.name: Tolmin Gorge
places.note: Slovenia's deepest gorge, a loop trail with a swing bridge over the confluence, quieter than anything near Bled. Open 09:00 to 15:00 until 15 Nov, 09:00 to 14:00 to 13 Dec, then closed 14 Dec until spring 2027; check the price.

places.name: Ljubljana old town and castle
places.note: Pleasant on foot, not worth adding an extra night for.

places.name: Vintgar Gorge (Winter Closure)
places.note: Boardwalks are removed roughly November to March for flood safety, so this whole gorge is not an option outside the April-October season. Plan around it if traveling in winter.

places.name: Lake Bled shoreline path
places.note: Full loop is about 6km and flat, best done at golden hour when the tour groups thin out. The view back at the island and castle from the north shore near the Vila Bled is the one you want.

places.name: Bled Island (Church of the Assumption)
places.note: Pletna boat from the lakeshore (rows daily all year), the 99 steps up to the church and the wishing bell, no extra fee. EUR 12 island ticket covers the church, bell tower and Provost's House; winter 08:30 to 16:00 Mon to Thu, to 17:00 Fri to Sun, boat fare extra.

places.name: Vintgar Gorge
places.note: Wooden walkways along the Radovna to the Šum waterfall, open April to October and closed now (November to March). Hours run 08:00 to 18:00 in July and August down to 09:00 to 15:00 from late September; go at opening, the All-in-One Pass is sold online.

places.name: Bled Castle
places.note: The cliff-top view over the lake is the reason to come; inside are archaeology finds, a National Museum of Slovenia exhibition and a Gutenberg press replica in the printing works. Winter 08:00 to 18:00 (summer to 20:00), adult EUR 19.

places.name: Slap Savica (Savica Waterfall)
places.note: About 25 to 30 minutes uphill on stone steps from the car park to the falls, quieter than anything at Bled. November and December 09:00 to 16:00, can shut for ice, snow or rockfall; EUR 4 from age 16, parking EUR 7 for 3 hours, no bus after 31 Aug.

places.name: Lake Bohinj
places.note: Quiet alpine lake, none of Bled's island-and-castle theatrics, good for a slow walk along the shore or a swim in summer before or after the Savica hike.

places.name: Vrsic Pass
places.note: Fifty-some hairpins over Slovenia's highest pass, no guardrails in places, reliably open June through October only. Check conditions before committing, the alternate via Kranjska Gora loses the views entirely.

places.name: Kozjak Waterfall walk
places.note: Easy trail along the Soca tributary through a narrow wooden-walkway canyon to a waterfall in a rock amphitheater. Better than the more famous Boka waterfall for the effort involved.

places.name: Old Mill Ruins near Gorge Exit
places.note: Modest stone remnants of a former mill near the far end, easy to miss and not signed well, but a quiet minute away from the crowd at Šum falls.

places.name: Mid-Gorge Overlook Platform
places.note: One of several small platforms jutting over the water partway through, worth pausing at even though it's not marked as a major stop.

places.name: Souvenir stalls at the gorge car park
places.note: Overpriced magnets and postcards aimed at the tour bus crowd, nothing here you can't buy in Bled town for less.

places.name: Radovna River Picnic Spot
places.note: Grassy riverbank near the entrance car park, decent spot to eat a packed lunch after the walk before driving to Bled Castle.

places.name: Vintgar Shuttle Bus (Zasip to Podhom)
places.note: Seasonal minibus that saves the walk back to the entrance car park. Runs irregularly, don't count on a fixed schedule.

places.name: Return Path via Zasip to Podhom
places.note: Marked path or minor road back to the car park if you skip the shuttle bus. Flat and unremarkable, just a way to close the loop on foot.

places.name: Church of St. Catherine, Zasip
places.note: Small church just beyond the gorge exit, a quiet stop while you wait for the shuttle bus back to Podhom.

places.name: Šum Waterfall
places.note: 13m waterfall at the far end of the gorge, the natural stopping point before you loop back to the road for St. Catherine's church.

places.name: Hom Bridge (Blejski Vintgar viewpoint)
places.note: Wooden bridge partway along with the best single photo angle down the gorge. Everyone stops here so it bottlenecks.

places.name: Vintgar Wooden Walkways over the Radovna
places.note: The main draw: pale turquoise river below, wooden walkways bolted to the rock. One-directional, no turning back once you commit, which keeps the crowd flow tolerable.

places.name: Vintgar Gorge Entrance (Podhom)
places.note: Ticket booth and start of the boardwalk, with a small paid car park a short walk away. Closed November to March; in season it opens 08:00 or 09:00 by month and shuts between 15:00 and 18:00, so arrive at opening.

places.name: Postojna Cave
places.note: Impressive formations but a full day for a guided train-and-walkway experience that runs like a theme park queue. Competes directly with the Soča Valley and Bled time already allotted.

places.name: Predjama Castle
places.note: An hour's drive from Ljubljana each way for a castle built into a cliff face. Photogenic but on this itinerary it competes with the Soča Valley and Bled days you've already spent; skip unless you add a night.

places.name: Ljubljanica Riverside Walk
places.note: Cafe-lined embankments on both sides of the river, this is the evening activity in Ljubljana: no ticket, no agenda, just walk it after dinner with everyone else.

places.name: Gostilna Pri Planincu
places.note: Gorenjska home cooking below the castle with large portions; order the goulash with trofie or the tarragon štruklji. Mains EUR 18.90 to 23.90 on the 2026 summer menu (winter dishes may differ), and a May 2026 review paid 64 euros for two dinners with wine.

places.name: Oštarija Peglez'n
places.note: Grill house in the centre: order the trout fillet or the mixed grill, and book ahead for the outside seats. One diner put dinner at 30 to 35 euros a head, an undated figure, so treat the price as a guide and check the November hours.

places.name: Bled Castle Restaurant
places.note: Venison and zander up at the castle, run by Jezeršek; from 18:00 it is the tasting menu only, so come at lunch for à la carte. Mains about 20 to 30 euros per an undated guide; book on +386 4 620 34 44.

places.name: Klobasarna
places.note: Sausage-and-stew counter for a cheap stand-up lunch: a large sausage was EUR 9.50 and stew with sausage 8.50 in July 2025. Sundays it shuts at 15:00 or 16:00 and the sources disagree on weekday hours, so hours vary, check.

places.name: Druga Violina
places.note: Social-enterprise restaurant on Stari trg for buckwheat dishes, soup and apple cake, lunch menu about 6 to 8 euros. Sources disagree on the closing day (Monday or Sunday) and the closing hour, so hours vary, check.

places.name: National Gallery of Slovenia
places.note: The national collection of Slovenian art, Tuesday to Sunday 10:00 to 18:00 and closed Mondays. Permanent collection about 8 euros per a 2025 listing, not the museum's own page, so check the price; give it 90 minutes.

outings.why: An easy boardwalk gorge walk that gets unbearable by 11am in July, so go at opening.
outings.name: Vintgar Gorge
outings.season: April to October, closes in winter when footbridges are pull

outings.why: The lake view from the walls is the whole point; the museum inside is filler.
outings.name: Bled Castle

outings.why: A full day including the drive and an uphill walk to the falls, quieter than Bled and better payoff per euro.
outings.name: Bohinj and the Savica waterfall

outings.why: Fifty-some hairpins with no guardrails in places, weather-dependent and only reliably open June through October; if closed, go around via Kranjska Gora and lose the views.
outings.name: Vršič Pass drive
outings.fallback: Detour via Kranjska Gora, losing the switchback overlooks.

outings.why: An easy river-side trail to a waterfall that beats the more famous Boka for the effort involved.
outings.name: Kozjak waterfall walk

outings.why: A gorge walk that's worth the entry and far less crowded than anything near Bled.
outings.name: Tolmin Gorge

outings.why: A pleasant half day on foot with a funicular up to the castle, not a reason to add nights.
outings.name: Ljubljana old town and castle

destination.name: Slovenia
destination.pitch: A week-long driving loop from alpine-lake postcard views at Bled to real mountains in the Soča Valley, bookended by Ljubljana for the flights.
destination.caveat: This is a driving trip on winding mountain roads so days run longer than the map suggests, and the whole itinerary's best day, the Vršič Pass, is weather-dependent and can vanish if it's closed or fogged in. Put together for you just now from a live search, so check anything you're pinning the trip on.

because.city: Ljubljana works fine as a one-night bookend, not as a destination in itself.
because.food: Self-catered breakfasts and one restaurant dinner a day is the realistic budget rhythm outside Ljubljana.
because.nature: Bohinj and Savica waterfall pay off more per euro than crowded Bled, and Tolmin Gorge and the Kozjak waterfall walk are quieter versions of the same idea.
because.culture: Ljubljana's old town and castle fill a pleasant half day but aren't a reason to add nights.
because.adventure: Fifty-some unguarded hairpins over the Vršič Pass is the real driving day of the trip.
because.relaxation: An evening walk around Bled lake is as close to slow as this trip gets.
because.exploration: The Soča Valley around Bovec and Kobarid is genuinely less trafficked than anything near Bled.
